races.display_title: Annual Members At Huntingdon Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: He may well have been no match for an odds-on favourite on his recent hurdling debut, but MY MATE AJ showed plenty to work on, so he gets the verdict to go a place better for the in-form Ben Pauling yard. The obvious danger is Double The Dance , who found one too strong in all 3 bumper starts last season and should make his mark as a hurdler. Talladale may prove best of the rest. MY MATE AJ (IRE) DOUBLE THE DANCE (IRE) TALLADALE

races.display_title: Conferences At Huntingdon 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CRYSTAL ISLAND arrives unbeaten having won an Irish point and both starts over hurdles and he looks the type to go on to even better things as a staying chaser. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate Reckless Spending , who also remains with potential as he makes the switch to chasing. CRYSTAL ISLAND (IRE) RECKLESS SPENDING (IRE) JOHN BARBOUR

races.verdict: EIGHTY EIGHT built on a promising stable debut to win comfortably at Chelmsford 18 days ago and remains well treated despite a 5 lb rise. races.verdict: SOVEREIGN BAY went like the best horse at the weights when narrowly denied on his yard debut over this C&D 21 days ago. The stable has an excellent record with this type of recruit and he can gain quick compensation. Hitched has won twice over C&D and is feared most after hinting at a revival last time, while Galba will find life tougher under a penalty but is respected. SOVEREIGN BAY (FR) HITCHED (IRE) GALBA

races.verdict: HERAKLES should be spot on for this following a couple of recent spins here and may well land a fourth C&D success. races.verdict: CONCERT BOY has a good record in this grade here and may resume winning ways off a quick turnaround. Barleybrown will probably be knocking on the door again, with Haltonwood one of a number who appeal off slipping marks. CONCERT BOY (IRE) BARLEYBROWN HALTONWOOD (IRE)
